candidates.summary: topaz and test13 VALIDATOR.md repeat sections 1-5 of the edited files and get no section 6.
candidates.failure_scenario: A topaz or test13 validator at a coordinated halt meets the same idle process with no guidance.
candidates.verify_by: ls misc/deployments/{topaz,test13}.gno.land/ for an UPGRADES.md and grep -n -i halt in their VALIDATOR.md: section 6 links ./UPGRADES.md and only fits a network that runs coordinated upgrades.

candidates.summary: `gnoland config get halt_height` reads ./gnoland-data/config/config.toml unless --config-path is passed, so the check run outside the node directory reads another file.
candidates.failure_scenario: An operator runs the check from their home directory while the node runs with a config elsewhere; the command reads a different or missing file.
candidates.verify_by: Run gnoland config get halt_height in an empty directory and in one holding a stale gnoland-data/config/config.toml: an error is loud, a stale file printing 0 is the silent case.
